question: Who among the following personalities is a Sangeet Natak Akademi award-winning folk dancer from Punjab?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balkar Singh Sidhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Balkar Singh Sidhu** is a renowned folk dancer from Punjab and a recipient of the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** is a national-level award given annually by the Government of India to artists for their exceptional contributions to performing arts.
